title: Castle reader: all / territory / tiles / canplace / raw

steps.note: Evidence 208 on save test1 read 'all count=1 owned=0' (plot 13, TestPlayer's) and 'raw plots=1 read=1'. The counts belong to the save, not to the code, so the expectations below assert the SHAPE of each line and the run's own numbers are printed in the matched line. A ghost owns no castle, so 'castle=none' is the expected answer everywhere a castle of the caller's own is wanted - that is what evidence 208 saw too.
A numeric PrefabGUID, so the reply does not depend on a spawnable-name lookup.
